about.subtitle: Our Story
about.title: Rooted in Heritage, Refined for Today
about.body1: Tibra was born from a deep love for the Arabian date palm — one of the oldest and most revered trees in the world. We believe that a truly exceptional date is more than a fruit; it is a story of land, season, and craftsmanship passed down through generations.
about.body2: From the volcanic soils of Madinah that nurture Ajwa, to the sun-drenched farms of Al-Qassim and the Jordanian valleys that produce the finest Medjool — every variety we source carries its own unique character and heritage.

features.title: Handpicked Selection

process.title: Source from the Finest Farms
process.text: We partner directly with trusted growers across Saudi Arabia, Jordan and beyond to source only the finest varieties each season.

process.title: Handpick & Quality Check
process.text: Each date is carefully handpicked and inspected by our experts to ensure it meets Tibra's strict standards of freshness and quality.

process.title: Pack & Deliver with Care
process.text: Packed in premium, eco-conscious packaging and shipped swiftly — so every Tibra date arrives as perfect as the day it was picked.

history.title: The Vision Begins
history.text: Tibra was founded with a single mission: to share the finest Arabian dates with the world, honoring centuries of date-farming heritage.

history.title: Expanding Our Farms
history.text: We forged direct partnerships with 15 premium farms across Saudi Arabia, Jordan and Egypt, securing exclusive access to the rarest varieties.

history.title: Going Global
history.text: Today Tibra delivers to over 40 countries worldwide — bringing the taste of Arabia's most prized dates to tables across the globe.

items.q: What types of dates does Tibra offer?
items.a: Tibra offers a premium selection of 9 date varieties sourced directly from their native regions, including Ajwa, Medjool, Safawi, Barni, Mabroom, Sagai, Khudri, Rutab, and Maftel dates.
Yes. All Tibra dates are completely natural with no preservatives, artificial additives, or chemical treatments. We ensure pure, authentic dates exactly as nature intended.
We ship to over 40 countries worldwide using premium, temperature-controlled packaging to ensure dates arrive fresh and in perfect condition. Delivery times vary by destination.

items.q: What is your minimum order quantity for B2B?
items.a: For B2B and wholesale orders, our minimum order is 20 kg per variety. Please contact us directly or use our B2B inquiry form for custom pricing and bulk availability.

items.q: How should I store dates after receiving them?
items.a: Store dates in an airtight container in a cool, dry place. For extended freshness (up to 12 months), refrigerate them. Avoid exposure to moisture and direct sunlight.
Yes! We offer premium gift packaging for all occasions including Ramadan, Eid, weddings, and corporate events. Customized branding is available for bulk B2B orders.

products.subtitle: Our Collection
products.title: Premium Date Varieties
products.description: Each variety is sourced directly from its native region and selected at peak ripeness — from the soft sweetness of Medjool to the rich depth of Ajwa.

items.name: Ajwa Dates
items.desc: The Prophet's ﷺ date — grown in the blessed soils of Madinah. Deep, rich flavor with extraordinary health benefits revered for centuries.

items.name: Medjool Dates
items.desc: King of dates. Impressively large with a soft, caramel-like texture and natural sweetness that melts on the tongue.

items.name: Safawi Dates
items.desc: Dark, moist and mildly sweet — Safawi dates have a soft, fudgy texture with a subtly complex flavor unique to Madinah.

items.name: Barni Dates
items.desc: Celebrated for their golden color and honey-like sweetness. Barni dates are a treasured variety known for their energy-giving properties.

items.name: Mabroom Dates
items.desc: Slender and elegant with a firm texture and semi-dry character. Mabroom dates offer a sophisticated, less-sweet experience.

items.name: Sagai Dates
items.desc: Distinctive two-toned dates with a dry, crinkled tip and a soft, moist base. Naturally sweet with a light, delicate flavor.

items.name: Khudri Dates
items.desc: Medium-sized with a wrinkled dark-brown skin. Khudri dates are mildly sweet with a chewy texture — a beloved everyday variety.

items.name: Rutab Dates
items.desc: Freshly ripened, soft and juicy — Rutab dates are available only in season. A rare, luxurious experience with intense natural sweetness.

items.name: Maftel Dates
items.desc: Uniquely soft with an amber, honey-colored flesh. Maftel dates are prized for their melt-in-the-mouth texture and rich, sweet flavor.
